title: CodexBar toy Upstash payload (inner, decoded from the {"result":"..."} envelope)
description: Hand-maintained. Producer: scripts/codexbar-stats.sh --json (usage % + extra-usage $) augmented by scripts/codexbar-publish.sh (Claude cost rollup from CodexBar's local cost cache). Consumer: firmware/main/stats_model.{h,c}. v1 = pre-cost {id,ok,p?,pr?,s?,sr?}; v2 is a strict superset adding the optional per-provider `cost` object. Firmware accepts v1 and v2; rejects other versions.

cost.description: v2 only. Present for Claude (cost-cache rollup) and OpenRouter (live keyDataFetched fields). Money is integer CENTS (LVGL has no float printf). Absent => firmware has_cost=false.

xu.description: Extra-usage overage used, cents (providerCost.used for Claude; keyUsage for OpenRouter). NOT total spend.

xl.description: Extra-usage overage limit, cents (providerCost.limit for Claude; keyLimit for OpenRouter).

ct.description: Total spend TODAY, cents (Claude: publisher rollup from cost cache; OpenRouter: keyUsageDaily).

cm.description: Total spend trailing 30 days, cents (Claude cost cache only).

tt.description: Tokens today (Claude: input+cacheRead+cacheCreate+output summed over models).

tm.description: Tokens trailing 30 days (Claude cost cache only).

cr.description: Account balance remaining, cents (OpenRouter: balance). Firmware credits_remaining_c.

cl.description: Total account credits, cents (OpenRouter: totalCredits). Firmware credits_limit_c.

h.description: Per-day total spend, cents, oldest -> newest (Claude only; firmware caps at STATS_HIST_MAX=31).

ph.description: v2 optional, Claude only. ~24h SESSION usage-% history (0..100), oldest -> newest, from CodexBar's hourly history file. Usage %, NOT cost. Absent => firmware pct_hist_n=0. Caps at STATS_PCT_HIST_MAX=24.

$comment: Cost source is CodexBar's local cache ~/Library/Caches/CodexBar/cost-usage/claude-v*.json days[date][model]=[input,cacheRead,cacheCreate,output,costNanos,rows,rows] (verified 2026-05-18). Only the `days` aggregate is read; the cache `files` map (private project paths) never leaves the Mac. Relaxed single-user privacy model: docs/SECURITY.md.
